clips.label: 消息疑点
clips.prompt: A restrained cinematic 2D Chinese anime suspense drama, 10 seconds horizontal letterboxed 16:9, cool neutral readable skin and black hair, consistent clean drawn linework. NIGHT outside a gray brick laundry beside a parked ambulance. ONLY TWO PEOPLE IN THIS VIDEO. Zhao Cheng is ONE injured 55 year old man with short gray hair, thin lined face, gray work jacket and small forehead dressing. He sits on ONE stretcher covered below waist with a silver emergency blanket. Lin Qian is ONE female detective short black bob hair navy police uniform. No other person. 0-4.4s medium close-up of Zhao seated, lips synchronized as he says in Mandarin at 0.8s: 我没给女儿发过消息。 4.4-10s cut to medium close-up Lin standing beside ambulance, Zhao outside the frame, she raises a radio to contact an OFFSCREEN colleague. At 5.7s Lin says exactly: 重新核实来电的人是谁。 Her lips match ONLY those words. Two shots, calm smooth movement, brief tense silent ending. No narrator, no extra words, no spoken stage instructions. Dialogue flows naturally. Ambulance interior is EMPTY, no second patient, no corpse, no background paramedic. No subtitles or text. Character reference is for Lin identity only, not its guardroom location. Clean production audio and quiet night ambience, no music.

subtitles.speaker: 赵成
subtitles.en: Yes. He said he'd kill me if I opened the back door.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.zh: 取下的布条单独留存，别混在一起。
subtitles.en: Keep the removed strips separate. Don't mix them.

subtitles.speaker: 急救员
subtitles.en: Understood. Let's get him to hospital.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: Have you checked the rear alley?

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: There's a speaker outside. It's still playing.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.en: Photograph it first. Don't touch the switch.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.zh: 楼上的脚步声也是录音？
subtitles.en: Were the upstairs footsteps a recording too?

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.zh: 这里只能解释后门的声音，楼上的还要查。
subtitles.en: This explains the sound here. Upstairs still needs checking.

subtitles.speaker: 赵成
subtitles.en: I never sent my daughter a message.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅（无线电）
subtitles.zh: 重新核实来电的人是谁。
subtitles.en: Recheck who that caller really is.
